    Base change of scalar mesh categories along a field extension #

    integral-deformations.tex (Section 10): "The all-one meshes […] define a graded category C⁽²⁾ with k ⊗_{𝔽₂} C⁽²⁾ = C. […] Evaluation identifies C⁽²⁾ with their full Hom category, since it does so after the faithful field extension to k."

    For a field extension K → k and coefficients u over K, extension of coefficients redE : C(Q, u) → C(Q, ι ∘ u) (ReductionMesh) is controlled by the coefficient retractions: for every K-linear θ : k → K, applying θ to the coefficients of path combinations (retP) maps the mesh ideal over k into the mesh ideal over K, so it descends to retE u θ : C(Q, ι ∘ u)(x, y) → C(Q, u)(x, y). It is a bimodule map over the morphisms coming from K (retE_comp_redE, retE_redE_comp) and retE u θ (λ • redE φ) = θ λ • φ. Consequently redE is injective, carries K-independent families to k-independent ones, its image spans, and the Hom spaces over K and k have the same dimension (finrank_redE).
